title: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 7, 2026 announcing the appointment of Dr. Richard Marshall as Chief Medical Officer, effective June 29, 2026. His compensation includes a $525,000 annual base salary, $250,000 sign-on bonus, and eligibility for up to 50% annual bonus plus equity grants.
